source: OS process creation time sampled while author was still running; overall parent acquisition ends when checkpoints.json is written, not exact process-exit time
scope: Creation-to-final-log wall time approximates overall authoring/admission/snapshot/index/removal setup. RSS sampling starts late and is not whole-run peak; CPU last sample may omit up to two seconds. Child checker costs are separately exact wait4 measurements. Complete process termination is bracketed by the OS samples, including teardown after the final log.
